title: GTA-Inspired PS5 Open World NTE Gets Tycoon Update in November
description: While the real GTA 6 approaches, Hotta Studio's anime-inspired open world NTE is getting a major update on November 11 featuring city logistics management and new characters.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Fresh Open World Option While We Wait for GTA 6

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster reaches an all-time high, gamers are constantly looking for titles to keep them occupied in the interim. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Push Square, Hotta Studio's anime-inspired open world game NTE is preparing a major update designed to offer players something fresh during this waiting period.

## What to Expect from the November 11 Update

Slated to release on 11th November, this upcoming patch brings a substantial amount of new content to the table. Most notably, the update introduces a brand-new city logistics management mode, shifting some of the focus toward a full-blown tycoon style of gameplay where players can manage logistics within the urban setting.

In addition to the tycoon-inspired mechanics, the update follows the game's established pattern by adding several core content pieces to keep the experience engaging. The update features:
- **New City Logistics Mode**: Manage city logistics and business operations in a fresh simulation style.
- **Two New Characters**: Expand your roster and experience new gameplay possibilities.
- **New Story Quests**: Dive deeper into the narrative and world lore.

While the real GTA 6 may be right around the corner, updates like this show how developer-driven content can provide alternative experiences for fans of open-world urban environments.

## Editor's Take
As the industry inevitably gears up for the eventual launch of GTA 6, it's fascinating to see other open-world titles carving out their own space through unique gameplay additions. Integrating city logistics and tycoon elements into NTE gives players a compelling reason to jump back in while waiting for Rockstar's masterpiece.
